all_fields.name: unity_catalog_provisioning_state
all_fields.description:
The provisioning state of the online table entity in Unity Catalog. This is distinct from the
state of the data synchronization pipeline (i.e. the table may be in "ACTIVE" but the pipeline
may be in "PROVISIONING" as it runs asynchronously).

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Delete an online table.
Warning: This will delete all the data in the online table. If the source Delta table was
deleted or modified since this Online Table was created, this will lose the data forever!
